skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze financial risks and their interrelationships, and apply risk management strategies in financial institutions.
Analyze the risk management processes and regulations in financial institutions.
Select and apply appropriate risk measurement models for financial institutions.
Collaborate effectively in group work, present research findings, and engage in class discussions.
Process and analyze data to support risk management decisions.
Understand and apply current financial regulations in risk management.
Assess and mitigate various types of financial risks.
Develop and implement risk mitigation strategies.
Communicate risk assessment and management strategies effectively.
Understand the dynamics of financial markets and their impact on risk management.
Utilize financial instruments to manage risk.
Prepare and interpret financial reports in the context of risk management.
